name: Starting circuit breaker
summary: Connects a machine to the electrical supply used during starting.
description: Connects a machine to the electrical supply used during starting.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the starting supply and machine connection. The associated drawing should trace the starting breaker control and status; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the starting supply and machine connection.

drawingChecklist: Label the starting supply and machine connection.

distinction: A starting breaker serves the start arrangement; device 42 identifies the normal running connection.
